semanticBoundaries.aggregation: sum(getValue), raw/aggregate normalization and path conventions are source-inspected only; no D3 hierarchy dependency is executed.
semanticBoundaries.identities: Treemap root-to-node dotpath keys permit repeated own IDs; Circle creation keys use own node.id and its path array is own-to-root; Icicle uid is hierarchy.path, own IDs may repeat across branches.
semanticBoundaries.labels: Treemap default node owns leaf/parent labels with independent flags and strict skip threshold; CirclePacking and Icicle labels are separate layers.
semanticBoundaries.eligibility: Computed zero-area/radius inputs are not filtered by these creation components. Icicle isVisible=false inputs still reach the wrapper and original focus handler requests zoom. Rust actual-Mark/focus/zero drawing eligibility must be stated separately.
